note: Conversion factors for the GreenOps translation engine. Every factor states its kind (measured | modeled | synthetic) and source. Starting values must be verified against the cited source before being presented as anything other than an illustration.

eastus.source: Illustrative annual-average location-based value for the demo. Replace with a cited annual average (e.g. Ember or Electricity Maps) for the grid serving this Azure region.

northeurope.source: Illustrative annual-average location-based value for the demo. Replace with a cited annual average for the grid serving this Azure region.

centralindia.source: Illustrative annual-average location-based value for the demo. Replace with a cited annual average for the grid serving this Azure region.

swedencentral.source: Illustrative low-carbon comparison region (not used by the subscription). Replace with a cited annual average.

pue.source: Starting value from the Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology (Azure). Verify at https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology before use.

compute.source: Starting values from the Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology (Azure average min/max watts per vCPU; memory coefficient). Verify before use.

storage.source: Starting values from the Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology (storage coefficients and replication factors). Verify before use.

embodied.source: Order-of-magnitude server manufacturing footprint over a 4-year life, in the style of the Cloud Carbon Footprint embodied-emissions method. Verify before use.

ai.source: Order-of-magnitude inference energy by model size from published studies (e.g. Luccioni et al. 2023). Providers do not publish per-token energy; treat as a wide-uncertainty estimate.

pipeline.source: Illustrative assumption: a dependency-cache miss adds about 40% to a run's duration. Replace with measured cached vs uncached run durations for the pipeline.
